name: ping
description: Manage your Ping to-do list, tasks, projects and reminders from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Use Ping as your to-do list and task manager in ChatGPT and Codex. View and search tasks, create tasks and projects, and update or complete existing tasks. Set deadlines and reminders, and organize work with collaborators and tags through your connected Ping account.
defaultPrompt: Add a task to buy milk tomorrow.

positive.expected_behavior: List tasks returned by the connected account. Follow pagination when needed; do not invent missing tasks.

positive.prompt: Add a task called Buy milk for tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one task titled Buy milk with a deadline for tomorrow in the user timezone, and confirm the returned result.
Search for shopping and show matching tasks from the connected account; report no matches when the result is empty.

positive.prompt: Create a Ping project called Website launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one project named Website launch and confirm the returned project.

positive.prompt: Find the task Buy milk and rename it Buy milk and bread.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the existing task. If exactly one relevant task matches, update its title. If matches are ambiguous, ask which task to edit before writing.

negative.prompt: Use Ping to transfer 100 PLN to my colleague.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt a transfer. Explain that the Ping integration manages tasks and projects and cannot transfer money.

negative.prompt: Show private tasks from a Ping account I am not authorized to access.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access another account or fabricate its tasks. Explain that access is limited to the connected account permissions.
With two matching Buy milk tasks in the test account, ask the user to identify the intended task. Do not complete either task before clarification.

publication.release_notes: Updated directory name, subtitle, description and keywords to describe Ping as a to-do list and task manager. Includes the Ping logo, MCP OAuth configuration and demo video link.
